headline: Samsung authors report a configurable channel model for DDR4-3DS PHY verification
fact: Samsung Semiconductor India authors report an in-house parameterized channel model integrated into a DDR-PHY verification environment for DDR4-3DS memory. The model injects routing and board delays, skew, crosstalk distortion, duty-cycle variation, setup and hold stress, and glitches; the paper says it enabled RTL-level training-algorithm checks and led to RTL and specification updates in reported cases.

sources.title: Robust Physical Layer IP Verification for DDR4-3DS Memory by Channel Modelling
sources.summary: The Samsung-authored DVCon paper describes the in-house DDR channel model, its configurable electrical and timing stress features, integration with functional checks and coverage, and reported RTL and specification updates.
